headline: Fierce Clashes Shake Mooring County as Expanse Strongholds Crumble
war_summary: Since our last dispatch, the grinding battle for Weathered Expanse has seen yet another fortified position battered into no-man's-land, leaving four bases ruined while Colonial forces hold four and Wardens cling to one amid more than two thousand fresh casualties over the past two hours. In Mooring County, Colonial troops managed to consolidate a fourth base against eight Warden redoubts, though brutal clashes around MacConmara Barrows and Gravekeeper's Holdfast consumed upwards of twenty-six hundred combined dead and wounded in the same span. Along Stlican Shelf, renewed skirmishing near Briar and Breaker Town reduced one stronghold to vacant ground, setting the ledger at seven Colonial outposts, one Warden, and one neutral. Meanwhile, fighting erupted in Palantine Berm with three rapid shifts over The Pippeli Stones before Wardens reaffirmed control over all seven sector bases. Elsewhere, intense attrition persists along Nevish Line and Linn of Mercy, where heavy casualties mount unabated even as strategic lines hold firm.
